 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meaning of the words given in the options and context of the passage.
 
 
• Here, the line **"We set sail the very next day and cruised from island to island in the fine weather". **
 
• **In the line **we landed, we found a crowd of merchants and clients eager it shows that every place.
 
• So the correct answer will be **Wherever.**
 
 
 
• So the correct answer is wherever. The complete line will be We set sail the very next day, and cruised from island to island in the fine weather. **Wherever **we landed we found a crowd of merchants

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Whatever:- Whatever can be used for saying that what happens is not important because it does not make any difference to a situation.
 
 
• Example:- I will love him **whatever** he does
 
 
 
• However:- "However" is used to Introduce Contrast and Contradiction.
 
 
• Example:- "I was very excited to be invited to lunch.** However,** I had already made plans."
 
 
 
• Somewhere:- Somewhere as an adverb is used to talk about someone or something being in or going to some specific place
 
 
• Example:- She left **somewhere** around 5 pm.
